items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: Not Schilling. Yeah, George Schilling. George Schilling. He's a nut, man.

ctx.x: And that's Eddie Powers next to De La Roche. Yeah, man.

The Sox section. Eddie Powers, I don't know what's his name, excuse me. Joe I-Kan, Eddie Powers. And this guy here, man, the third Sox here, Joe Foice, Eddie Antena, and my boy here, I can't think of that. The one that went crazy? Yeah, his dad's band for years, Spock band, man. She danced through at the old drawers years ago, man. Old man, what the hell was his name again? He's a nut, man, that guy. Good musician, that boy. Not Schilling. Yeah, George Schilling. George Schilling. He's a nut, man. Oh, yeah. Yeah,…

They say they made a movie out there once, but I never heard about it. I saw something with the camera. I don't know what that happened to the movies. Were you in it? Yeah. You were in the movie, huh?
